$comment: The addon set and THE one version number, read by CI (to build the release archives and
ADDONS.json), by the knockbox CLI's release tooling, and by AddonManifestTests.cs.
One shared sdkVersion covers every client addon and the CLI. Before this file there were five
hand-maintained numbers for artifacts the docs claimed moved together (godot 0.1.0, phaser
0.2.0, web 0.1.0, pack-game 0.2.0 twice over) and nothing kept them honest. Bump here; the
test fails until every declared versionFile agrees.
Compatibility with a server is NOT expressed by matching the server's version — it is
minAppVersion/maxAppVersion, exactly as a marketplace catalog entry expresses it, compared
against Hosting/KnockBoxVersion.cs with SemVer from Marketplace/PluginVersion.cs. So an addon
release does not force a server release, or the reverse.
maxAppVersion is null = no upper bound. An UNPARSEABLE bound counts as incompatible (the rule
PluginUpdateEvaluator already applies): a constraint we cannot read is not the absence of one.

phaser.description: Phaser 3 global plugin, protocol core, authority helper and server-less local peer.

web.description: Reference vanilla-JS SDK. Normally served by the platform at /knockbox.js — install it only to vendor a pinned copy (offline dev, or an engine export that bundles rather than depends on the platform).

cli.$comment: Not a runtime addon — the build-time packer/installer, published to npm. Rides the same version so there is exactly one number to bump.
